newsitem.title: USA: Primark sells gas storage unit to Coastal.
newsitem.headline: Primark sells gas storage unit to Coastal.

text.p: Primark Corp said Tuesday it has sold its natural gas storage facility to American Natural Resources Co, a subsidiary of Coastal Corp. The sale of Primark Storage Leasing Corp was a cash transaction for $14.3 million, the company said.
The company said $28.7 million of non-recourse debt will be removed from its balance sheet after the sale.
Primark said it has been leasing the storage capacity of the facility to an affiliate of American Natural Resources under a long term lease.

"This was the one piece of the gas business that Primark has held on to as we completed our transformation into a technology and information services company," said Primark spokesman Jim Flanagan. "This ends our foray in the energy sector."
